#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>

const int N = 20;
const double eps = 1e-5;

int n;
int m;

double p[N];
double res[1 << N];
double q[N];

void scan() {
	std::cin >> n >> m;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) std::cin >> p[i];
}

void preprocess() {
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) res[1 << i] = p[i];
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) q[i] = 0;
}

void ntt() {
	for (int i = 1; i < (1 << n); i++) {
		vi v, w;
		double sum = 0;
		for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
			if ((i >> j) & 1)
				v.pb(j);
			else {
				w.pb(j);
				sum += p[j];
			}
		if (sz(v) == m || (sz(v) < m && sum < eps)) {
			for (auto x : v) q[x] += res[i];
		} else
		if (sz(v) < m) {
			for (auto x : w) res[i | (1 << x)] += res[i] * p[x] / sum;
		}
	}
}

void print() {
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(15) << q[i] << " ";
	std::cout << "\n";
}

int main() {
	scan();
	preprocess();
	ntt();
	print();
	return 0;
}
